Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to move to a hands-on POC. We'd like to schedule a kickoff working session to cover: prompt review/tuning, routing behavior (multi-model & failover), and an initial set of load tests / benchmarking.

High-level targets to validate during the POC:
- Throughput: target sustained 500 requests/sec for our main prompt path
- Latency SLOs: p50 ~150ms, p95 < 300ms (token generation included)
- Test harness must simulate realistic user think-times and KV cache warmups

Are you available for a 2.5-hour working session next week? We can include our infra lead (Sanjay) for the load test portion.

Thanks,

Adding a quick technical note for the load-test portion so we can be aligned pre-POC: 

- Test harness: we typically accept JMeter/Locust scripts; if you send JMeter we can run it on Redwood Dedicated. Please include a sample CSV for prompts and a small KV-warmup script.
- Ramp plan suggestion: 5m ramp to target, 20m sustain, 5m ramp down for the initial smoke. For extended benchmarking we can do 30m sustained windows.
- Metrics to collect: p50/p95/p99 for end-to-end generation, tokens/sec, GPU util, memory pressure, and tail latencies during model-switch events.
- Warm cache important: plan for several prefix requests to prime KV cache before the measurement window.
- We will need an API key to run tests; we can provide a scoped key with rate limits and audit logging enabled.

I'll be prepared to walk through the load_test_plan.csv during the 11:30 block and can share a small example JMeter script if useful.

—Dev
Staff Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
